text: An incorrect parking amendment was included in an item for Brock Avenue that was adopted by Toronto and East York Community Council at its meeting on July 8, 2025. The recommendations below will correct this error while maintaining the parking changes requested by Brock Avenue residents.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item TE24.61 entitled "Brock Avenue - Parking Amendments”. 2. Deleted Part 6 of its decision with respect to Item TE24.61.
